ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white surface comprising approximately 85% of visible area, contrasted against low-intensity black margins and focal spots comprising 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black boundary along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. A central vertical low-intensity triangular intrusion extends from the peduncle into the median notch. Multiple discrete low-intensity punctate blobs are scattered across the medial regions of both high-intensity white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 20% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire span; peaks and valleys show pixel-amplitude variations between 5 and 15 pixels relative to the smoothed edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double convex curve; the lobes exhibit a prominent upward sweep towards the distal tips from the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 12 discrete, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (scars) ranging from 10 to 30 pixels in diameter, primarily concentrated in the medial and lower-medial sectors of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark-intensity diagonal linear disruption on the right distal lobe; multiple faint, horizontally-aligned gray-scale pixel disruptions on the left proximal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Bilateral yellowish-brown chromatic patches (possible diatoms or biological staining) observed on the lower mid-sections of both fluke lobes; various non-pigmented punctate scars.
